<h2> Description </h2>
'''M-60''' is the 2nd entity you'll encounter within the [[Section M]].

<h2> Behavior </h2>
When '''M-60''' spawns, [[Oblivion]] will mark one or more random lockers in the main room with a red "Ⅹ", indicating that '''M-60''' will check them. After a few seconds after the locker was been marked, '''M-60''' will rush to the main room with a similiar speed to [[A-60]]. Upon hitting the door, '''M-60''' has a chance of destroying it, which might cause it to spawn one of the [[Section M]]'s entities. After hitting or breaking the door, '''M-60''' will proceed to the marked lockers and will check them, instantly despawning after checking them all.

<h2> Strategy & Tips </h2>
* It is not that hard to deal with '''M-60''', just simply hide in the unmarked locker or in the previous room to survive.
* Avoid rushing too much. '''M-60''' might take a bit long to arrive once spawned, but if you need to hide in a blue locker because of [[M-120]] for example, the blue locker might be marked and you'll die by '''M-60''' or [[M-120]] if it mimics [[A-135]] or [[D-55]].
* If [[Oblivion]] is not present, it is best to hide in the previous room if possible.

<h2> Trivia </h2>
* '''M-60''' is one of the few ''Multimonsters'' that checks lockers. Only '''M-60''', [[M-60i]] and [[D-140i]] that are legit ''Multimonsters'' that checks/destroy lockers ([[D-60i]] destroys lockers in phase 2, but it is not considered as a Locker Checker, so it doesn't count.)
* '''M-60''' now able to check tables, just like A-60 (firstly sniping and then killing if in sight). However, its prime [[M-60i|Mediator]] still cannot check tables. So, if necessary, you can use them as hiding spot without being spotted by entity.
* '''M-60''' has a very small chance of checking a locker in the pr<nowiki/>evious room (has a higher chance of doing if there is almost no lockers in the main room).
* Lockers wont be marked by [[Oblivion]] during Perfection Events, due to [[Overseer]] taking their place for the events.

<h2> Description </h2>
'''I-60''' is the 3rd and final Entity present within the final 100 rooms of [[Section UI]] (not including [[Gato|<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px #FFFA00; color: #000000;">Gato</span>]]), more info on '''I-60''' shown below.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
When '''I-60''' spawns, it will make loud static sounds from behind you before rushing to the main room, once it hits the door, it will go towards a random locker in the main room and check it, staying idle infront of it for 4 seconds before despawning.

<h2> Strategy & Tips </h2>
* You should always hide in a previous room, hide in main room only as a last resort, since I-60 may have a chance of checking your locker.
* you should stay hidden for the full encounter or, if in a previous room, get out and look back at the previous rooms, so you dont get surprised and killed by [[E-30#Section_UI|I-30]]
